# ORA Head Spa & Wellness

> Herbal head spa in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA. Botanical scalp and skin rituals of 60 to 90 minutes, one therapist to one guest. ORA is the Waltham studio of TOUCHEER, a herbal scalp care brand founded in 1998.

## Brand facts

- Name: ORA Head Spa & Wellness (also written ORA Toucheer, ORA Head Spa)
- Parent brand: TOUCHEER, founded 1998, 10,000+ locations in 5+ countries
- Location: Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 10:00–21:00
- Price range: $169–$189 per ritual; annual membership $288; gift cards $25–$1,000
- Service model: one-to-one, 60–90 minutes per visit
- Website: https://www.myoraspa.com
- Booking: online, at https://www.myoraspa.com/preview#booking

## Rituals

- Pure Reset — 60 minutes — $179. Cleanses oil and styling residue, rebalances the scalp and releases tightness. Best for oily scalps and product build-up.
- Vital Glow — 75 minutes — $169. Deep-cleanses, feeds the scalp with botanical care and smooths the hair. Best for dry, dull or weighed-down hair.
- Deep Stillness — 90 minutes — $188.99. Extends cleansing and slow massage from scalp to neck and shoulders. Best for screen fatigue and shoulder tension.

Every ritual follows five steps: consultation, scalp check, warm botanical cleanse, slow massage from scalp to neck and shoulders, then a quiet rest.

## Offers

- ORA Annual Membership — $288 per year: 10% off every ritual, one complimentary ritual (Pure Reset or Vital Glow), 20% off retail products.
- ORA Gift Card — $25 to $1,000, redeemable in store for any ritual.

- Prices are in USD and exclude gratuity unless stated.
- Cancellations or changes within 24 hours incur a 15% fee; no-shows incur 50%.
- Content is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, German and Russian via the language switcher.
